reason: I'd grab the free first visit for sure, but we'd only go once or twice a month, so a membership doesn't pay off and $14 a visit plus a sibling adds up fast when there are free library story times and parks. I'd wait and see if a Groupon shows up.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month, not enough to justify a membership, and drop-in at $14 plus $7 for the second kid is a lot for an hour or two.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or a 5-visit pack at around $35-40, or an off-peak shift-worker weekday rate that makes each visit about $8-9.
